name: unraid-control
description: Full control of an Unraid server (Unraid OS 7.x, live-verified on 7.3.2 / unraid-api 4.35.1) from Claude Code. Bundles an MCP server that authenticates to Unraid's official GraphQL API (api-key auth) and exposes both a generic GraphQL passthrough reaching the entire schema (Query/Mutation/Subscription, bundled offline since live introspection is disabled by default) and 90 curated tools for system health, the array & disks, Docker containers, VMs, shares, notifications, UPS, network, users/API keys, plugins and logs — plus a control skill and slash-command workflows. Also ships an opt-in SSH layer closing the gaps in Unraid's GraphQL API (which can operate but not create): editing a container's env vars, plus a full deployment layer — deploy custom containers and Community Applications apps as native dockerMan templates, compose stacks (auto-installs Compose Manager), and create VMs (vdisk + OVMF/q35 libvirt domain). All create/deploy/delete tools are confirm-gated and protected VMs are refused.
